searchText: Hi everyone, if EIP-4844 enables a DA layer. Could this potentially provide file sharing/hosting as well? Even though blobs will eventually be purged cycled. I can see a sort of pinning service exist for keeping data available as long as someone pays for it, correct? At least arbitrary data can already be put into the calldata on L1 (see https://ethfs.xyz/). However this is still expensive. So, new dApps would 'exploit' this 'feature', right? So, there would be a possibility for L1 (eternal storage) and L2 (temporary storage + pinning) seems just like an inevitability or am I missing something? Thanks for sharing your insights The EVM has no access to the contents of the blobs and can merely check a hash. So … not sure how useful that is for sharing anything other than proofs At least that’s my understanding which is shaky Yorick is correct, but you're also not wrong 🙂 One would have to build out a means of recovering that data based on the proved availability. For example, you could commit to an IPFS hash on chain, and build any kind of logic around that you like.
